CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hpf_identity (
  ghl_contact_id   text PRIMARY KEY,
  phone_raw        text,
  phone_e164       text,
  session_id       text NOT NULL,
  kommo_entity_id  text,
  kommo_contact_id text,
  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hpf_identity_session_idx ON hpf_identity (session_id);
INSERT INTO hpf_identity (ghl_contact_id, phone_e164, session_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $2 || '2131')
ON CONFLICT (ghl_contact_id) DO UPDATE SET
  phone_e164 = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone_e164, hpf_identity.phone_e164),
  -- Repara SOLO las filas que escribió la derivación vieja (la que borraba el '+'),
  -- comparando contra esa fórmula exacta. Cualquier otro session_id se respeta:
  -- pisarle la clave de memoria a un lead con conversación abierta le borra el
  -- historial, que es justo lo que este mecanismo tiene que evitar.
  session_id = CASE
    WHEN hpf_identity.session_id = regexp_replace(
           COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone_e164, hpf_identity.phone_e164), '\D', '', 'g') || '2131'
     AND EXCLUDED.session_id IS DISTINCT FROM hpf_identity.session_id
    THEN EXCLUDED.session_id
    ELSE hpf_identity.session_id
  END
RETURNING session_id, ghl_contact_id;

SELECT CASE
  WHEN to_regclass('public.n8n_chat_histories') IS NULL THEN 0
  ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM n8n_chat_histories
        WHERE session_id = $1 AND message->>'type' = 'human')
END::int AS turnos_previos;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hpf_seguimientos (
  session_id          text PRIMARY KEY,
  contact_id          text NOT NULL,
  opportunity_id      text,
  campania            text,
  etapa_al_armar      text,
  evento              text,
  ola                 int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  proximo_at          timestamptz,
  desde_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  evaluacion_at       timestamptz,
  evaluacion_desde_at timestamptz,
  ultimo_inbound_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  ultimo_toque_at     timestamptz,
  cerrado_at          timestamptz,
  cerrado_motivo      text,
  bloqueado_hasta     timestamptz,
  actualizado_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO hpf_seguimientos (session_id, contact_id, opportunity_id, campania,
  etapa_al_armar, evento, ola, proximo_at, evaluacion_at, evaluacion_desde_at,
  desde_at, ultimo_inbound_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,0,$7::timestamptz,$8::timestamptz,$9::timestamptz,now(),now())
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  contact_id     = EXCLUDED.contact_id,
  opportunity_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.opportunity_id, hpf_seguimientos.opportunity_id),
  campania       = EXCLUDED.campania,
  etapa_al_armar = EXCLUDED.etapa_al_armar,
  evento         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.evento, hpf_seguimientos.evento),
  ola            = 0,
  proximo_at     = EXCLUDED.proximo_at,
  evaluacion_at  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.evaluacion_at, hpf_seguimientos.evaluacion_at),
  evaluacion_desde_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.evaluacion_desde_at,
                                 hpf_seguimientos.evaluacion_desde_at),
  desde_at          = now(),
  ultimo_inbound_at = now(),
  cerrado_at = NULL, cerrado_motivo = NULL, bloqueado_hasta = NULL,
  actualizado_at = now()
RETURNING session_id, campania, proximo_at, evaluacion_at;
